international.title: Tories select James Cleverly as candidate for London mayor
international.summary: Former home secretary wins 86% support in a membership vote to stand in May 2028 James Cleverly has been chosen by the Conservatives as their candidate in the next London mayoral election and says he will stand up to “anti-London” Andy Burnham. Cleverly, who stood down as shadow communities secretary in August to focus on his mayoral ambitions, was overwhelmingly chosen in a vote of London Tory members from a three-strong shortlist, winning 86% of the ballot.
